q: 昨天已经很热了，今天比昨天___热，大家都不想出门。
zh: 昨天已经很热了，今天比昨天还热，大家都不想出门。
py: zuó tiān yǐ jīng hěn rè le jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān hái rè dà jiā dōu bù xiǎng chū mén
en: It was already hot yesterday, and today is even hotter than yesterday; nobody wants to go out.
why: In a 比 sentence only 更 or 还 may stand before the adjective, here meaning 'even hotter'. 很, 太 and 有点儿 cannot be placed there.

q: 这个周末比上个周末___冷。
zh: 这个周末比上个周末冷。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò bǐ shàng gè zhōu mò lěng
en: This weekend is colder than last weekend.
why: After 比 B the adjective stands bare, so nothing goes before 冷. 很 and 非常 are degree words that clash with 比.

q: 虽然秋天早上已经很凉快，但是冬天早上比秋天___冷，我们只好穿羽绒服。
zh: 虽然秋天早上已经很凉快，但是冬天早上比秋天更冷，我们只好穿羽绒服。
py: suī rán qiū tiān zǎo shàng yǐ jīng hěn liáng kuai dàn shì dōng tiān zǎo shàng bǐ qiū tiān gèng lěng wǒ men zhǐ hǎo chuān yǔ róng fú
en: Autumn mornings are already cool, but winter mornings are even colder than autumn ones, so we had to put on down jackets.
why: 更 is the degree word that fits a 比 sentence and means 'even colder'. 非常, 太 and 比较 cannot be put before the adjective once 比 is used.

q: 今年冬天比去年冷___，去年穿一件毛衣就够了，今年得穿羽绒服。
zh: 今年冬天比去年冷得多，去年穿一件毛衣就够了，今年得穿羽绒服。
py: jīn nián dōng tiān bǐ qù nián lěng de duō qù nián chuān yī jiàn máo yī jiù gòu le jīn nián dé chuān yǔ róng fú
en: This winter is much colder than last winter; last year one sweater was enough, this year I need a down jacket.
why: A big difference is 得多 after the adjective. 一点儿 means only a little and clashes with the context, and 很 or 有点儿 cannot follow the adjective.

q: 我家比朋友家离公司近___，只差五分钟的路。
zh: 我家比朋友家离公司近一点儿，只差五分钟的路。
py: wǒ jiā bǐ péng you jiā lí gōng sī jìn yī diǎn r zhǐ chà wǔ fēn zhōng de lù
en: My home is a bit closer to the office than my friend's; it is only five minutes' difference.
why: A small difference is 一点儿 after the adjective. 多了 would mean 'much closer', which the five-minute gap contradicts, and 很 or 有点儿 cannot go after the adjective.

q: 我弟弟比我小___，他今年才十八。
zh: 我弟弟比我小三岁，他今年才十八。
py: wǒ dì di bǐ wǒ xiǎo sān suì tā jīn nián cái shí bā
en: My younger brother is three years younger than me; he is only eighteen this year.
why: An exact age gap is number + 岁 placed after 小. 三个岁 is never said, and 有点儿 cannot follow the adjective.

q: 这家饭馆比那家便宜___，我们去这家吧。
zh: 这家饭馆比那家便宜十块，我们去这家吧。
py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn bǐ nà jiā pián yi shí kuài wǒ men qù zhè jiā ba
en: This restaurant is ten yuan cheaper than that one; let's go to this one.
why: The size of the difference follows the adjective: 便宜十块. 很 and 有点儿 cannot go after the adjective.

q: 听说下个月的天气会比这个月凉快___，到时候我们再约朋友去爬山吧。
zh: 听说下个月的天气会比这个月凉快一些，到时候我们再约朋友去爬山吧。
py: tīng shuō xià gè yuè de tiān qì huì bǐ zhè ge yuè liáng kuai yī xiē dào shí hou wǒ men zài yuē péng you qù pá shān ba
en: I hear next month will be a bit cooler than this month; let's invite friends to go hiking then.
why: A small difference after the adjective is 一点儿 or 一些. 有些, 很 and 非常 cannot follow an adjective as an amount in a 比 sentence.

q: 今天___昨天那么冷，不用穿厚外套。
zh: 今天没有昨天那么冷，不用穿厚外套。
py: jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me lěng bù yòng chuān hòu wài tào
en: Today is not as cold as yesterday; you don't need a thick coat.
why: 'Not as ... as' is A 没有 B 那么 + adjective. 比 would say it is colder, and 不比 or 不如 do not take 那么 + adjective this way.

q: 今年的春天没有去年___暖和，花还没开呢。
zh: 今年的春天没有去年那么暖和，花还没开呢。
py: jīn nián de chūn tiān méi yǒu qù nián nà me nuǎn huo huā hái méi kāi ne
en: This spring is not as warm as last spring; the flowers haven't bloomed yet.
why: After 没有 B only 这么 or 那么 may come before the adjective. 很, 非常 and 更 cannot be used in this slot.

q: 我跑得没有他___快，所以每次比赛都输。
zh: 我跑得没有他那么快，所以每次比赛都输。
py: wǒ pǎo dé méi yǒu tā nà me kuài suǒ yǐ měi cì bǐ sài dōu shū
en: I don't run as fast as he does, so I lose every race.
why: With 没有 the adjective stays plain and may take 那么 before it. 很 cannot come before it, and amounts such as 得多 or 一点儿 cannot follow it.

q: 虽然预报说有大雨，但是真正下起来，雨没有预报说的___大，我们还是出发了。
zh: 虽然预报说有大雨，但是真正下起来，雨没有预报说的那么大，我们还是出发了。
py: suī rán yù bào shuō yǒu dà yǔ dàn shì zhēn zhèng xià qǐ lái yǔ méi yǒu yù bào shuō de nà me dà wǒ men hái shì chū fā le
en: The forecast said heavy rain, but when it actually came, the rain was not as heavy as forecast, so we set off anyway.
why: 没有 B 那么 + adjective expresses 'not as ... as'. 很, 比较 and 更 cannot replace 那么 inside a 没有 comparison.

q: 你说今天比昨天热？我觉得今天___昨天热，都是三十五度。
zh: 你说今天比昨天热？我觉得今天不比昨天热，都是三十五度。
py: nǐ shuō jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān rè wǒ jué de jīn tiān bù bǐ zuó tiān rè dōu shì sān shí wǔ dù
en: You say today is hotter than yesterday? I think today is no hotter than yesterday; both are thirty-five degrees.
why: 不比 means 'not more than' and allows equality, which fits 'both thirty-five'. 没有 and 不如 say it is clearly less, and 比 says it is more.

q: 春天风太大了，出去玩还___在家看电影舒服。
zh: 春天风太大了，出去玩还不如在家看电影舒服。
py: chūn tiān fēng tài dà le chū qù wán hái bù rú zài jiā kàn diàn yǐng shū fu
en: The wind is too strong in spring; going out is not as pleasant as watching a film at home.
why: 还不如 means 'not even as good as'. 比 or 更 would claim going out is more comfortable, which the strong wind contradicts.

q: 他的汉语不如我___，所以他很羡慕我。
zh: 他的汉语不如我好，所以他很羡慕我。
py: tā de hàn yǔ bù rú wǒ hǎo suǒ yǐ tā hěn xiàn mù wǒ
en: His Chinese is not as good as mine, so he envies me.
why: After 不如 the adjective must be a positive one: 不如我好. 差 or 不好 would be a double negative and does not make sense.

q: 今天的雨不如昨天___，路上不难走。
zh: 今天的雨不如昨天大，路上不难走。
py: jīn tiān de yǔ bù rú zuó tiān dà lù shàng bù nán zǒu
en: Today's rain is not as heavy as yesterday's; the road isn't hard to walk.
why: 不如 is followed by the positive end of the scale (大), meaning 'less heavy'. 不如 + 小 would mean 'less light' and is wrong.

q: 你说秋天比春天舒服，可我觉得秋天___春天，我们这儿的秋天太干了。
zh: 你说秋天比春天舒服，可我觉得秋天不如春天，我们这儿的秋天太干了。
py: nǐ shuō qiū tiān bǐ chūn tiān shū fu kě wǒ jué de qiū tiān bù rú chūn tiān wǒ men zhè ér de qiū tiān tài gàn le
en: You say autumn is more pleasant than spring, but I think autumn is not as good as spring; autumn here is too dry.
why: 不如 can end the sentence without an adjective: 'is not as good as'. 没有 needs an adjective, 不比 needs one too, and 比 says the opposite.

q: 我们这儿的冬天___北京一样冷，每年都下雪。
zh: 我们这儿的冬天跟北京一样冷，每年都下雪。
py: wǒ men zhè ér de dōng tiān gēn běi jīng yī yàng lěng měi nián dōu xià xuě
en: Winter here is as cold as in Beijing; it snows every year.
why: Sameness is 跟 or 和 + B + 一样. 比 always marks a difference, and 没有 or 不如 would say 'less cold'.

q: 今天的气温跟昨天一样___，出门最好带件外套。
zh: 今天的气温跟昨天一样低，出门最好带件外套。
py: jīn tiān de qì wēn gēn zuó tiān yī yàng dī chū mén zuì hǎo dài jiàn wài tào
en: Today's temperature is as low as yesterday's, so you had better take a jacket.
why: The adjective after 一样 is bare: 一样低. 很 and 非常 cannot be added there, and 一点儿 is an amount that belongs to 比, not 一样.

q: 这个春天和去年的春天___，都很暖和。
zh: 这个春天和去年的春天一样，都很暖和。
py: zhè ge chūn tiān hé qù nián de chūn tiān yī yàng dōu hěn nuǎn huo
en: This spring is the same as last spring; both are warm.
why: 和 + B + 一样 says the two are alike, matching 都很暖和. 不一样 says they differ, which the second half contradicts.

q: 他跟他哥哥一点儿也___，性格完全不同。
zh: 他跟他哥哥一点儿也不一样，性格完全不同。
py: tā gēn tā gē ge yī diǎn r yě bù yī yàng xìng gé wán quán bù tóng
en: He is nothing like his older brother; their personalities are completely different.
why: 一点儿也 must go with a negative, so 不一样 is needed; 一样 would contradict 完全不同. 没有 and 不如 are not used after 跟 here.

q: 在我们五个人当中，小李唱歌唱得___好，别人都比不上他。
zh: 在我们五个人当中，小李唱歌唱得最好，别人都比不上他。
py: zài wǒ men wǔ gè rén dāng zhōng xiǎo lǐ chàng gē chàng dé zuì hǎo bié rén dōu bǐ bù shàng tā
en: Among the five of us, Xiao Li sings best; nobody else can match him.
why: A group of several people points to 最 for the top one. 更 needs a single comparison, and 比较 means only 'fairly' and clashes with 比不上他.

q: 春天已经很舒服了，可是秋天___舒服，所以我最喜欢秋天。
zh: 春天已经很舒服了，可是秋天更舒服，所以我最喜欢秋天。
py: chūn tiān yǐ jīng hěn shū fu le kě shì qiū tiān gèng shū fu suǒ yǐ wǒ zuì xǐ huan qiū tiān
en: Spring is already very pleasant, but autumn is even more pleasant, so I like autumn best.
why: 更 means 'even more' than something just mentioned. 很, 比较 and 有点儿 do not carry that 'even' meaning after 可是.

q: 我们学校离地铁站___近，走路只要五分钟。
zh: 我们学校离地铁站比较近，走路只要五分钟。
py: wǒ men xué xiào lí dì tiě zhàn bǐ jiào jìn zǒu lù zhǐ yào wǔ fēn zhōng
en: Our school is fairly close to the subway station; it takes only five minutes on foot.
why: 比较 before an adjective means 'fairly' and names no B. 比, 没有 and 不如 all need a second thing to compare with.

q: 一年四季里，我___喜欢秋天，其他三个季节都比不上。
zh: 一年四季里，我最喜欢秋天，其他三个季节都比不上。
py: yī nián sì jì lǐ wǒ zuì xǐ huan qiū tiān qí tā sān gè jì jié dōu bǐ bù shàng
en: Of the four seasons I like autumn best; the other three can't compare.
why: 最 picks the top from a group (the four seasons). 比较 is only 'rather', which does not fit 比不上, and 越 or 有点儿 do not belong before 喜欢.

q: 姐姐比我吃___多，可是她一点儿也不胖。
zh: 姐姐比我吃得多，可是她一点儿也不胖。
py: jiě jie bǐ wǒ chī de duō kě shì tā yī diǎn r yě bù pàng
en: My older sister eats more than I do, yet she isn't fat at all.
why: Comparing how much someone does uses 吃得多; 得 links the verb to the adjective, even after 比我. 了, 着 and 过 do not link a verb to a degree.

q: 妹妹唱歌___得比我好听，大家都喜欢听她唱。
zh: 妹妹唱歌唱得比我好听，大家都喜欢听她唱。
py: mèi mei chàng gē chàng dé bǐ wǒ hǎo tīng dà jiā dōu xǐ huan tīng tā chàng
en: My younger sister sings better than I do; everyone likes listening to her.
why: With an object (唱歌) the verb is repeated before 得: 唱歌唱得比我好听. Without the repeated 唱 the pattern is incomplete.

q: 这个周末的聚会，小张到___比我们都早，一个人在门口等了很久。
zh: 这个周末的聚会，小张到得比我们都早，一个人在门口等了很久。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò de jù huì xiǎo zhāng dào dé bǐ wǒ men dōu zǎo yí gè rén zài mén kǒu děng le hěn jiǔ
en: At this weekend's get-together Xiao Zhang arrived earlier than all of us and waited alone at the door for a long time.
why: How early someone arrives is a 得 complement: 到得比我们都早. 着, 了 and 过 cannot link a verb to its manner.

q: 他跑得___我快，所以第一个到终点的是他。
zh: 他跑得比我快，所以第一个到终点的是他。
py: tā pǎo dé bǐ wǒ kuài suǒ yǐ dì yí gè dào zhōng diǎn de shì tā
en: He runs faster than I do, so he was the first to reach the finish line.
why: 比 sits right after 得 when the comparison follows the verb: 跑得比我快. 没有 would say he is slower, and 跟 or 更 cannot stand in for 比.

q: 去年冬天的朋友聚会，小张唱歌唱___比我们每个人都好听，让大家都很惊讶。
zh: 去年冬天的朋友聚会，小张唱歌唱得比我们每个人都好听，让大家都很惊讶。
py: qù nián dōng tiān de péng you jù huì xiǎo zhāng chàng gē chàng dé bǐ wǒ men měi gè rén dōu hǎo tīng ràng dà jiā dōu hěn jīng yà
en: At last winter's gathering of friends, Xiao Zhang sang better than any of us, which surprised everyone.
why: 唱歌唱得比我们每个人都好听 needs 得 to link the verb to the compared quality. 了, 着 and 过 mark aspect, not degree.

q: 天气越来越___了，该穿羽绒服了。
zh: 天气越来越冷了，该穿羽绒服了。
py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le gāi chuān yǔ róng fú le
en: The weather is getting colder and colder; it is time to wear a down jacket.
why: 越来越 is followed by a bare adjective. 很 and 更 would double the degree, and 冷得 is an unfinished complement.

q: 最近我们见面的机会越来越少___，大家都太忙了。
zh: 最近我们见面的机会越来越少了，大家都太忙了。
py: zuì jìn wǒ men jiàn miàn de jī huì yuè lái yuè shǎo le dà jiā dōu tài máng le
en: We have fewer and fewer chances to meet lately; everyone is too busy.
why: 越来越 + adjective usually ends with 了 to mark the change. 着, 过 and 的 do not mark a change of state.

q: 他汉语说得越来越___，我们都为他高兴。
zh: 他汉语说得越来越好，我们都为他高兴。
py: tā hàn yǔ shuō dé yuè lái yuè hǎo wǒ men dōu wèi tā gāo xìng
en: His Chinese is getting better and better, and we are all happy for him.
why: After 越来越 the adjective is bare: 好. 很好 and 更好 add a second degree word, which 越来越 already covers.

q: 他滑雪滑___越来越好了，今年冬天已经可以去高山了。
zh: 他滑雪滑得越来越好了，今年冬天已经可以去高山了。
py: tā huá xuě huá dé yuè lái yuè hǎo le jīn nián dōng tiān yǐ jīng kě yǐ qù gāo shān le
en: He skis better and better; this winter he can already go to the high mountains.
why: With an action verb, 越来越 goes after 得 in the complement: 滑得越来越好. 着, 过 and 了 cannot connect the verb to that complement.

q: 夏天快到了，天气越来越___，晚上睡觉也越来越不舒服了。
zh: 夏天快到了，天气越来越热，晚上睡觉也越来越不舒服了。
py: xià tiān kuài dào le tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè wǎn shàng shuì jiào yě yuè lái yuè bù shū fú le
en: Summer is coming and the weather is getting hotter and hotter; sleeping at night is getting more and more uncomfortable.
why: 越来越 already supplies the degree, so the adjective stands bare. 很热, 非常热 and 太热 cannot follow it.

zh: 秋天比夏天凉快。
py: qiū tiān bǐ xià tiān liáng kuai
en: Autumn is cooler than summer.
why: The pattern is A 比 B + adjective: 比 夏天 comes before 凉快. English 'than' after the adjective is the trap.

zh: 明天比今天还冷。
py: míng tiān bǐ jīn tiān hái lěng
en: Tomorrow will be even colder than today.
why: 还 sits between 比 B and the adjective to mean 'even'. It cannot come before 比 or after 冷.

zh: 我朋友的家比我家更靠近公园。
py: wǒ péng you de jiā bǐ wǒ jiā gèng kào jìn gōng yuán
en: My friend's home is even closer to the park than my home.
why: 更 goes right before the verb phrase 靠近公园 in a 比 sentence, after 比 B. It cannot precede 比.

zh: 昨天比前天冷三度。
py: zuó tiān bǐ qián tiān lěng sān dù
en: Yesterday was three degrees colder than the day before yesterday.
why: The amount of difference comes after the adjective: 冷三度. Putting 三度 before 冷 is the English-order mistake.

zh: 上海的冬天比北京的冬天暖和一点儿。
py: shàng hǎi de dōng tiān bǐ běi jīng de dōng tiān nuǎn huo yī diǎn r
en: Winters in Shanghai are a bit warmer than winters in Beijing.
why: 一点儿 closes the sentence after the adjective. 有点儿 or 很 cannot take its place inside a 比 sentence.

zh: 我的朋友比我大三岁。
py: wǒ de péng you bǐ wǒ dà sān suì
en: My friend is three years older than me.
why: Ages use 大 or 小 followed by number + 岁: 大三岁. The number cannot be placed before 大.

zh: 北京的春天没有上海的暖和。
py: běi jīng de chūn tiān méi yǒu shàng hǎi de nuǎn huo
en: Spring in Beijing is not as warm as Shanghai's.
why: 'Not as ... as' is A 没有 B + adjective. Using 比 plus 不 before the adjective is wrong.

zh: 我跑得没有朋友快。
py: wǒ pǎo dé méi yǒu péng you kuài
en: I don't run as fast as my friend.
why: In a 没有 comparison of actions the 得 complement keeps the adjective last: 跑得没有朋友快.

zh: 我的汉语没有他的那么好。
py: wǒ de hàn yǔ méi yǒu tā de nà me hǎo
en: My Chinese is not as good as his.
why: 那么 stands directly before the adjective after 没有 B. It cannot follow 好 or come before 没有.

zh: 夏天去爬山没有去游泳凉快。
py: xià tiān qù pá shān méi yǒu qù yóu yǒng liáng kuai
en: In summer, going hiking is not as cool as going swimming.
why: Both activities are verb phrases, and the adjective 凉快 closes the 没有 comparison. A 比 + 不 order is wrong.

zh: 今天不比昨天冷。
py: jīn tiān bù bǐ zuó tiān lěng
en: Today is no colder than yesterday.
why: 不 goes before 比, never before the adjective. It says 'not more than' and leaves room for equality.

zh: 我的汉语不如他的好。
py: wǒ de hàn yǔ bù rú tā de hǎo
en: My Chinese is not as good as his.
why: 不如 replaces 比, and the adjective that follows is a positive one (好).

zh: 在家看书不如出去走走有意思。
py: zài jiā kàn shū bù rú chū qù zǒu zǒu yǒu yì si
en: Reading at home is not as interesting as going out for a walk.
why: 不如 links two activities, and the positive adjective 有意思 comes last. 比 cannot be combined with it.

zh: 我的生日跟他的一样。
py: wǒ de shēng rì gēn tā de yī yàng
en: My birthday is the same as his.
why: A 跟 B 一样 puts 跟 B before 一样. 一样 cannot come before 跟.

zh: 今天的天气跟昨天一样好。
py: jīn tiān de tiān qì gēn zuó tiān yī yàng hǎo
en: Today's weather is as good as yesterday's.
why: The adjective follows 一样 directly: 一样好. It cannot be placed before 跟.

zh: 我和朋友一样喜欢下雪。
